title: TVO Arts
description: In a style inspired by tradition, Christi Belcourt's "The Wisdom of the Universe" reveals that the wonders of the natural world are worth fighting for.

title: Hope for Wildlife
description: Hope's first orphaned mammal arrives earlier than ever; a mysterious patient from last year returns.

title: Citizen Minutes
description: Three fearless community organizers with a history of standing up against big tech corporations, embark on an uphill political fight to regulate Uber and Lyft in Toronto so that these companies operate in the public interest.

title: All-Round Champion
description: Sierra and two-time Pan Am Games champion Mandy Bujold train the athletes in boxing; with two gold medals on the line, the athletes fight to make it to the podium.

title: Jasmine & Jambo
description: The Garden of Instruments is untidy and Jambo can't find his grandmother's violin; Jasmine finds it, but she accidentally breaks the strings; she replaces them with more unconventional ones: a cat hair, a shoelace, a guitar string and a washing line.

title: Ladybird and Bee
description: For Ladybird and Bee, Wild Meadow is the whole world; it's a place of big adventure, big fun and big friendship for the tiny creatures who call it home.

title: Donkey Hodie
description: Donkey and Panda host King Friday for a day.

title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
description: Clifford is excited for dog food delivery day; but when the boat docks with a new kind of dog food, Clifford panics.

title: Colourblocks
description: The Colourblocks learn that mixing red and yellow makes orange; adding black and white helps to make darker and lighter colors; when the printing crew arrives, we learn how they work together to mix their colors and create new ones.

title: Bamboo Loves Music
description: Upon finding an instrument case, Bamboo Love curiously wonders what's inside; she quickly opens it and guesses it is a guitar; she tries and tries but can't get it right; before giving up, two birds fly in with the bow stick and gracefully pass it over the strings creating a magical sound; grabbing hold of the bow, Bamboo Love tries and is mesmerized by the rich music the Violin offers.

title: Wolf Joe
description: Joe and his friends are looking forward to the outdoor movie screening on the beach, but Hank hasn't shown up with the projection equipment; the kids discover he has had some bad luck on his journey and must rescue him in time for the movie night.

title: Odo
description: Leonardo is convinced that Odo saved his life and sticks to Odo like glue, causing Odo a lot of trouble.

title: Pip and Posy
description: Pip and Posy work together to make Zac a mermaid's tail made out of sand, adding pebbles and leaves as decorations; when Posy's leaves end up going missing, she accuses Pip of taking them.

title: Kid-E-Cats
description: Uncle Muffin invites the kittens to his movie studio; soon Dad vanishes, and they find their uncle battling a monster on set, but something isn't quite as it seems.

title: Kangaroo Beach
description: Four junior lifeguards work under the guidance and encouragement of mature lifeguards to become heroes of Kangaroo Beach.

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: A living vine wraps itself around the feet of Ginger and Kid Broce, binding them together; after some trial and error, the pair get used to moving as one, so much so that they don't want to become untangled!

title: Riley Rocket
description: The newspaper is looking for a local Changemaker and Theo thinks Riley would be the perfect candidate; Megablast decides to try writing a disco song; Starlet hatches a plan to give away merch to help make her comeback.

title: Isadora Moon
description: Isadora gets Mirabelle to help her prepare a potion to fake an illness and avoid a maths test, but the magic backfires.

title: PAW Patrol
description: Francois builds a person-sized solar system attraction to celebrate the appearance of a shooting star; but when the remote control goes haywire, it sends the attraction soaring; Lizzy returns from Adventure City with a priceless family heirloom; but when her bag gets mixed up with Danny's stunt bag, the PAW Patrol need to find him and swap the cases before Danny gets hurt.

title: Interstellar Ella
description: Madhu is on a mission to find rubies for Madwhy, but Ella and Slippy keep playing and getting distracted. Madhu tries being assertive but goes too far and becomes bossy. They soon learn that no one likes a bossy person, even if they are a friend! Then, Ella becomes jealous when she sees Slippy and Mom bonding over a comet. She tries to come between them with disastrous effect, before realizing there's more than enough Mom to go around.

title: Burps, Butts and Bones
description: A medical skeleton named Bones answers body-related questions that are sent in by real-life children, while a squad of kid reporters known as the B Team find out more about the topic.

title: B.O.T. and The Beasties
description: The Wonky Flier wants to fly up to the stars; the small propeller on its head is not up to the job. B.O.T. must help the beastie get airborne and complete the mission at the same time.

title: Odd Squad
description: Omni and Osric are desperate to get off the night shift and go to a party, but they must first stop a mysterious villain; Orwell and Okra must prevent a flying machine from stinking up Odd Squad's favorite places.

title: Work It Out Wombats!
description: All aboard the Moo Moo Choo Choo; visiting great uncle Duper in the Windborhood; world's biggest whirligig blows away; helping great uncle Duper imagine how to build a new one.

title: ScienceXplosion
description: Eric creates a floating compass and discovers how it can help him understand his treasure map to find the treasure; learning how a compass uses the earth's magnetic field to point north and south.

title: The Screen Team
description: After their phones suddenly stop working, Reid and Leia go to a repair shop to learn how devices are fixed. They explore common tech problems, tiny internal parts and why the right to repair means you don't always need a new phone.

title: Colourblocks
description: The Printing Crew come to the rescue and show the color explorers that when they mix they can make lots of different colors.

title: The Singalings
description: Inquisitive and eager extraterrestrials discover all they can about Earth.

title: Mia & Codie
description: Codie wants to play the music for Velvet's show, only he doesn't have enough space in his block dock for an entire melody; when Mia presents him with a macro block, Codie becomes a music bot, playing a melody that gets everyone dancing.

title: Bamboo Loves Music
description: Bamboo Love learns that a Flute is an airy woodwind instrument that plays graceful, flowing music with poetic brilliance. Embracing a new instrument, Bamboo Love realizes the light silvery flute is the perfect instrument to learn how to play. With some help from her feathery friends, Bamboo Love learns that the flute is played horizontally and is harder than it looks.

title: Numberblocks
description: The Numberblocks perform a song and dance about making a whole.

title: ABC With Kenny G
description: Kenny G sings about the letter X to his usual crowd of animals, explaining what's so extraordinary about xylophones, foxes and counting to 60.

title: The Coco Boo
description: Yum and Yoyo make a giant cake.

title: Polly Can Do
description: When their big sea adventure on the wooden Pirate Ship in the sandbox area doesn't go as planned, it looks like Polly and her friends' search for a giant squid will have to be abandoned until Polly comes up with a fun way to keep the game going.

title: ABC SingSong
description: What to do, where to go; a song about the word directions.

title: JoJo & Gran Gran
description: JoJo and Gran Gran visit the woods, keeping a record of all they find on a journey stick; looking around, they find lots of fallen flowers, leaves, seeds and bark to decorate their stick.

title: BooSnoo!
description: A unique blend of calm and exploration provides the chance to reset as a red ball embarks on a fantastical adventure filled with art and creativity.

title: Jasmine & Jambo
description: The friends are playing music together, but when it's Doodoowah's turn, he just stays silent and doesn't play at all; Doodoowah gets up and walks off, leading them all to a place where they have no choice but to be quiet.

title: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
description: Gwen Ifill shows Yadina that asking questions is a great way to get information; Matthew Henson shows Xavier and Brad that they can learn from each other.

title: Raven's Quest
description: Keena is an 11-year-old Mohawk girl who lives in Kahnawà:ke, Que.; Keena brings everyone to a gathering place in the community, then Keena and her best friend Lynnen go fishing, play badminton, make a smoothie, and show their secret handshake.

title: Wordsville
description: When Reporter Read's RATIONAL paperweight is stolen, everyone becomes irrational. Even worse, since they were the last ones in the newsroom, Gabby and Sly are the suspects! Reporter Read turns to Singer Melody and Baker Graham to solve the mystery and be Word Detectives! Luckily, Gabby and Sly manage to fight their irrationality to crack the case.

title: PAW Patrol
description: Francois is directing a video when his camera crane rolls away; all the farm animals go missing from the Super Farm Fair.

title: Audrey's Shelter
description: Audrey, a seven-year-old, lives in an animal refuge for endangered species.

title: Interstellar Ella
description: Slippy and Ella can't agree on what fun adventure they will go on together so they each head off on their own; then, Ella wants to be just like her mom and plans to skate, scooter race and geyser jump her way to a trophy!

title: 16 Hudson
description: Luc, Lola, and their Safety Cat Kensington explain why it's important to ask before touching something that isn't yours.

title: Wolf Joe
description: Buddy finds himself in a basketball shooting competition with his dad, Chief Madwe, so he needs to learn how to sink a basket double quick.

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes get caught in the middle of out-of-control rolling Coconutdons and tail swatting Pineapplesaurus.

title: JoJo & Gran Gran
description: Captain Chloe's adventures through space inspire JoJo and Gran Gran to visit the space center and planetarium. After returning to Gran Gran's house, they try to see if any planets are out.

title: The Game Catchers
description: The Game Catchers land on the Color Planet and learn the game Find The Pair. While making materials to play the game, the group learns about creating many colors, starting with just blue, yellow, and red; then, the Game Catchers land on the Play Park Planet, where they learn the game The Balloon Caterpillar; but before they're able to play, they'll have to cheer a local up to help him learn how to fly.

title: Olga da Polga
description: The Sawdusts are going on holiday; Mrs. Sawdust reveals Olga is being taken to you know where; it turns out to be a guinea pig holiday home with an eager audience for Olga's tales!

title: Pip and Posy
description: The friends put together a circus with everyone performing a different circus skill; Frankie tries everyone else's skill but isn't very good at them.

title: Dr. Cheddar
description: Annie has a new balloon, but doesn't think she needs to share it with Felix; Dr. Cheddar surprises Annie when he uses her reasoning to take the balloon for himself.

title: Bamboo Loves Parasports
description: Bamboo Love and friends learn and experience the similarities and differences between Badminton and Para Badminton with help from real-world parasport video examples.

title: Animanimals
description: The mouse rescues a starving beaver from an island using his wooden ship.

title: Woolly Woolly
description: BeeBee and ChooChoo try to catch the mythical Woolfoot.

title: Super Mighty Makers
description: Bondini and Chris help Chase make something to help clean his room that he shares with his brother.

title: Tiny and Tall
description: Tiny and Tall are trying to track down the source of a mysterious rumbling. To help them search, Tall invents a device that can show them how close they're getting to the strange sound!

title: Caillou
description: A messy park gets in the way of a paper boat race; Caillou doesn't understand the rules of a game.

title: Animanimals
description: The tiger is supposed to perform a daring circus trick, but he's too scared to go through with it.

title: Donkey Hodie
description: After getting too much water, Donkey's new flower grows too big and disrupts her garden.

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes find the Jungle Park teeming with other baby Vegesaurs, leaving practically no room for them to play; so the gang must get creative to create a game that they can all join in on.

title: Kangaroo Beach
description: Along with everyone at Kangaroo Beach, Gemma is distracted from her lifeguard duties by a pair of whales and misses an important rescue; in the water a curious whale gets beached while "wombat watching.".

title: Space Kids
description: Exploring nebulae, giant clouds of dust and gas in space.

title: The Rhythm and Roots of Arthur
description: Arthur's family and Buster take a trip to the Read family farm where they learn about traditions and family.

title: Rosie's Rules
description: Things get out of control when Rosie starts a pet-sitting business; Rosie plays with a rock from Javi's rock collection.

title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
description: After reading about Robin Hood, Clifford is determined to become Birdwell Island's own do-gooder, Clifford the Good, but after doing a bunch of little good deeds around the Island, Clifford fears he isn't really making a difference.

title: Odd Squad
description: Ms. O tells a story about a famous villain duo.

title: Wild Kratts
description: The Kratt Bros. discover there is an old wily orca who only eats large sharks; they find this hard to believe, so with the help of Aviva's dolphin decoder, modified to speak orca, the Wild Kratts go in search of the orca who likes sharks.

title: Collar of Duty Kids
description: A service dog named Andy offers comfort and support to a little girl with a rare genetic disorder; kids stretch with the llamas and breathe with the goats on an animal therapy farm in rural New Brunswick; a six-year-old boy who experiences seizures, finds more ways to play with his service dog named Mia by his side.

title: Mr. Hugo's Little Library
description: Librarian Mr. Hugo is uneasy when Georgie, Arlo and Tia enter his magical Library. But after reading a story about a selfish dragon who learns to share, Mr. Hugo has a revelation.

title: Big Top Academy
description: Chaos ensues during the mid-term student showcase when Chase goes missing, and April's old ballet school nemesis shows up to see her big performance.

title: Ainara's Bookshelf
description: After a deep-dive into "Beatrice and Croc Harry" from author Lawrence Hill, Ainara jumps on her bike to meet him deep in the forest to discuss talking animals, wordplay, self-identity and oatmeal.

title: Chatsworth House: A Great British Year
description: It's March 2020, the house emerges from deep winter hibernation anticipating a bumper year of visitors and events; but just a few days before the grand opening, coronavirus starts to infect the process.

title: Citizen Minutes
description: Mufflers, honks, and drilling make up the perpetual soundscape of Toronto; fed up with sleepless nights, a couple of activists take the fight to city hall in the hopes of changing the outdated noise bylaws.

title: Mountains: Life Above the Clouds
description: The Andes is the longest mountain range in the world and home to astonishing hidden worlds, extraordinary animals and remarkable people. Featuring a puma hunt, bears searching for water in scorched forests and a newly discovered shapeshifting frog.

title: California Typewriter
description: A look at the people who remain loyal to the typewriter as a tool and muse, and a portrait of California Typewriter, a typewriter service and sales company in Berkeley that has been in business since 1949.

title: The Sit-In: Harry Belafonte Hosts The Tonight Show
description: In early 1968, as riots rock American cities and the Vietnam War escalates, the legendary entertainer and activist Harry Belafonte takes over "The Tonight Show" for one week. With a guest list that includes Bobby Kennedy, Aretha Franklin, Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and Sidney Poitier, Belafonte introduces a fractured, changing country to itself for five historic nights.

title: Citizen Minutes
description: Writer and community organizer Dave Meslin thinks that bad public notices are hurting democracy, and he's calling on graphic designers to show what's missing.

title: Chatsworth House: A Great British Year
description: It's March 2020, the house emerges from deep winter hibernation anticipating a bumper year of visitors and events; but just a few days before the grand opening, coronavirus starts to infect the process.

description: A look at the people who remain loyal to the typewriter as a tool and muse, and a portrait of California Typewriter, a typewriter service and sales company in Berkeley that has been in business since 1949.

With a guest list that includes Bobby Kennedy, Aretha Franklin, Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and Sidney Poitier, Belafonte introduces a fractured, changing country to itself for five historic nights.

title: All-Round Champion
description: Phoebe teaches the athletes that dancing takes just as much agility, technique, and skill as any other sport; with the help of choreographer Amanda Cleghorn, she gets the athletes competition-ready in just three days.

title: Wacky Media Songs
description: Ava designs a package as she sings about the different packaging tricks marketers use to convince kids to want to buy their product.

title: Ladybird and Bee
description: Boin and Bee play hide and seek, but struggle to find their friend the grasshopper.

title: Urban Tails
description: Miss Seal, the oceanic hip hop queen, bobs her head up and down in the water to the beat; in her video, "It's the Grey Seal," she showcases her impressive rapping and swimming skills that enable her to seize that all-important catch of the day.

title: Polly Can Do
description: When Polly and her friends decide to play soccer in the playground, Referee Stephie starts inventing rules to make the game easier for herself, Bella and Polly, but in doing so, spoils it for Cody; that's when Polly gets an idea.

title: Clifford the Big Red Dog
description: Jack has officially outgrown his favorite tennis shoes, but he can't imagine life without them; as he tries to break in the new shoes, his friends try every tactic imaginable to make him feel better about the change.

title: Dr. Cheddar
description: When Annie accidentally breaks Felix's toy plane, she tries everything she can think of to hide it from him; she realizes that the truth is the only way out of her predicament.

title: Canada Crew
description: Bebe shares her pictures of forest animals with Mo; Gavin meets some wolverines; zookeeper Carl drops by with Raksha, the Arctic wolf pup.

title: Donkey Hodie
description: Duck Duck builds a book swap box but has trouble giving away her books.

title: Be With Zee
description: Zee has been looking forward to flying their kite all week, but things don't always go as planned.

title: The Very Small Creatures
description: Blue is sleeping on one of the carrots that were meant for the toy animals at the farm; Yellow and Orange have to try and retrieve it without waking Blue up.

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: Ginger can't get a wink of sleep when the baby Pea-Rexes start snoring loudly; the real problems begin when they start sleepwalking right into harm's way.

title: The Game Catchers
description: The Game Catchers land on the Color Planet and learn the game Find The Pair. While making materials to play the game, the group learns about creating many colors, starting with just blue, yellow, and red; then, the Game Catchers land on the Play Park Planet, where they learn the game The Balloon Caterpillar; but before they're able to play, they'll have to cheer a local up to help him learn how to fly.

title: Bumpadoo!
description: Bumpi joins LiLi at her easel, drawing different things around her room. As she figures out what shapes are needed she teaches Bumpi. When it is his turn to draw he makes sure to use all the shapes!... But what is it?

title: M is for Me
description: Meet 6-year-old Bennett! He is a proud bilingual Brazilian-Canadian who loves sharing his culture. Bennett is super excited about animals, books and teaching friends a few words in Portuguese!

title: Caillou
description: The home and social life of a sensitive and imaginative four-year-old boy and the supportive family and friends that help him navigate his big feelings.

title: Carl the Collector
description: Carl loves the new sweater his Pop Pop knit him, but it feels itchy when he wears it; Carl is nervous about his new school bus stop.

title: Rosie's Rules
description: Rosie and Javi's pirate adventure goes awry; Rosie has trouble choosing a job at the first Fun Club meeting.

title: Flower & Flour
description: Flower is a seven-year-old girl living above her parents' restaurant; by her side is Flour, a cat created from a bag of flour; they live in a multicultural neighborhood and have various experiences together.

title: PAW Patrol
description: After Danny's baseball accident, Digi and Tal create a bouncy safety suit for him to wear; but when Danny bounces away, the PAW Patrol have to find him; Francois' fancy fromage goes missing before the cheese competition, and with Chase's nose plagued by allergies, he enlists Squeak the mouse to lead the rescue.

title: Audrey's Shelter
description: Jack does not adjust well to the arrival of a new baby gorilla, Kimia; with the adults away, Audrey and Tommy have to protect Kimia from traffickers.

title: Dino Dexter
description: When Dex's sister Saara brings home a blue-tongued skink without a tail, Dex and Kayla wonder if some lizards can drop and regrow their tails, what about dinosaurs?

title: 16 Hudson
description: When Lili sees the new superintendent for 16 Hudson, she decides there's more than meets the eye, and she's determined to get the real story.

title: Woolly Woolly
description: Marco's drawing is mysteriously smudged, while the Wool Patrol investigates dangerous holes appearing all across Woollywood.

title: Odd Squad
description: Olympia and Otis must call a truce between feuding guests.

title: Secrets Of The Forest
description: Soil is filled with its own mysteries and history; alongside scientists from Lakehead University, Taviss gets deep in the dirt to discover how soil is alive.

title: Wild Kratts
description: The Wild Kratts search for the snub-nosed monkeys in the Chinese mountains.

title: MojoSwoptops
description: Fabio's sticky sauce gets him stuck to Mojo. Is there really no way to unstick them?

title: Tiny and Tall
description: Tall is sad: his favorite stuffie is damaged! Tall doesn't have enough happy feelings inside him to play with Tiny, today. He uses rocks in a bottle to show Tiny how much happiness he has. The bottle is almost empty! Tiny decides that, maybe, she can share some of her happy feelings with her friend! Tiny tries her best to cheer up her blue buddy.

title: Run the Marbles
description: It's a karaoke run; Koralee and Ben build a sing-along marble run; let's hear you sing!

title: The Treebees
description: A Traditional Yoruba children's song about the gathering of the community under the local lime tree to play, sing, dance, and be happy together. Sung in both English and Yoruba languages.

title: Kid-E-Cats
description: One day Pudding saves up enough money to buy himself a robocat and he is very careful with his new toy, and does not let anybody play with it; Pudding is afraid that the other kittens might break it.

title: Urban Tails
description: In his video, "Bob your head," Pidgey-P raps about himself; Pigeons like Pidgey-P flock to cities in droves in the hope of getting bird seed or other food.

title: Momolu and Friends
description: Pepe, Nooni, Banni and Momolu find themselves on slippery slopes after an ice storm; unable to travel, they find a soft solution by working together using crafting, nature and determination.

title: ABC SingSong
description: It's doing good things for bodies and minds; a song about the word healthy.

title: Pip and Posy
description: Posy accidentally leaves out Mo when the friends form a band.

title: Colourblocks
description: Imaginative Purple arrives in Colorland; the Colorblocks discuss the color purple.

title: 16 Hudson
description: Sam, Lili, and their Safety Cat Kensington explain how to be safe when using a computer to avoid viruses.

title: B.O.T. and The Beasties
description: The Drifty Shouters like to drift about, but they really love shouting as loud as they can; they are so loud that B.O.T. is rattled to pieces; the mission becomes even trickier when the Drifty Shouters find a way to make their shouts even louder.

title: Curious Crafting
description: Mandisa shows off a craft of a koala that looks like it's climbing a tree; Katie and Michael each paint two paper plates gray before using them to create the koala's body, then cut construction paper for bamboo, add googly eyes and a big black nose.

title: Odo
description: Welcoming kids ages three to five to a world full of possibilities and teaching how to deal with setbacks in a meaningful way while promoting the development of self-efficacy and self-confidence.

title: Green Squad
description: Meet Alen, math whiz, piano player, and eco-hero in training! He wants to grow a veggie garden without wasting drinking water. So the Green Squad teams up to explore how water gets cleaned at a high-tech treatment plant (hello ozone, UV light, and giant filters!). Inspired to save H2O, Alen learns about using rain barrels and builds one himself from an old garbage bin! Alen even writes a planet-saving jam that totally steals the spotlight. Squad up and sing along—Water on tap, chooga-chooga-ch!

title: Run the Marbles
description: Koralee and Ben build a playground-inspired marble run that ends with some fun in the sand!

title: Jasmine & Jambo
description: Jasmine discovers Jambo's collection of vinyl records; shortly after, some of Jambo's most prized records start to disappear; Jambo and Jasmine investigate and discover that Dudua is to blame, but is also the solution.

title: The Wacky Word Show
description: Zoey and Lukas meet a cowboy named Silent E and a rodeo queen named Onomatopoeia and find out why some words aren't spelled the way they sound; Lukas tries to program the Booboo Bot to use contractions, which almost causes the bot to explode.

title: Step by Step Let's Dance
description: Dancers mash up K-pop and swing in the streets of Asia.

title: Animanimals
description: The rhino is looking forward to his date with the rhino lady.

title: Trading Skills
description: Brody visits an animal hospital in Meaford, Ontario to meet Jennifer, a veterinary technician. Jennifer and Brody perform a physical exam on a young pup named Rosie, checking her eyes, ears, teeth and heart. Brody prepares microscope slides and takes a close look at ear swab samples, revealing creepy, crawly ear mites! Jennifer and Brody prepare Larry the Labrador for surgery, which includes shaving his fur, inserting an IV catheter, delivering anaesthetic and hooking up an oxygen mask.

title: PAW Patrol
description: Adventure Bay is getting a new airport! Sweetie tries to take the Princess' place at the grand opening.

title: MojoSwoptops
description: As Tao can't go on with his circus performance, Bo agrees to do all the acts for him with some help from Mojo's tops.

title: Dream It to Be It
description: It's game on as Tai meets his latest dreamer, 10-year-old Dominic, a video game guru; to give Dominic a chance to level up on his dreams, Tai takes him to two different game studios where Dominic gets a taste of everything the video game industry can offer.

title: Abby Hatcher
description: Abby wants to make the best Chinese New Year's celebration for her Wai Po; Teeny Terry wants to go to the moon to see the Fuzzly in the Moon.

title: B.O.T. and The Beasties
description: The chilly Snowy Shover is pushing a large pile of snow; the pile gets bigger and bigger and the Snowy Shover gets colder and colder.

title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
description: Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes help a young Cornasaurolophus reach the top of a hot volcano where the heat will make its kernels pop and allow a fresh new coat.

title: JoJo & Gran Gran
description: JoJo & Gran Gran celebrate Creole Day and Gran Gran teaches Jojo some words in Creole.

title: Colourblocks
description: The Printing Crew come to the rescue and show the color explorers that when they mix they can make lots of different colors.

title: Numberblocks
description: The adventures of friends who can always count on each other.

title: Kid-E-Cats
description: One day Cookie, Candy and Pudding are on their first train trip and everything around them seems new and unusual; when they take a stop at Catfield station, Mommy and the kittens accidentally get left behind!

title: Olga da Polga
description: Mr. Sawdust has a surprise for Olga, a guinea pig friend; apparently, her new roommate is a real star; could Olga's new roommate be famous guinea pig celebrity, Daisy La Squeak?

title: Animanimals
description: In an ocean full of fish, the puffer fish is trying to seem as big and strong as possible.

title: Woolly Woolly
description: Pirouette tries to stop an old friend of Josie's from visiting.

title: Super Mighty Makers
description: Bondini, Holly and Scarlett make a fidget toy for Keith, who gets nervous when he rides the bus.

title: Happy Place
description: The muddle collect winter clothing for those in need, discovering the joy of giving.

title: Cutie Pugs
description: Birdie tells the pugs what it's like to be a bird and Dee Dee flies a kite.

title: Opie's Home
description: Opie can't wait for Mom to come home from work. He does anything he can to speed up time including changing the clocks and building a time machine. The activities keep him so busy that time does seem to fly by.

title: Jasmine & Jambo
description: Jasmine tries to teach Dudua and Dubidu to play the drums, but they don't pick it up; Jambo shows them a map of the forest and tells them that, if they follow the instructions, they will find the rhythm.

title: Caillou
description: When Caillou finds a tiger toy on the school yard, he needs to return lost things to their rightful owner.

title: Donkey Hodie
description: Donkey accidentally breaks Grampy's favorite toy; Donkey and Panda play with a new Tater Buddy.

title: Animanimals
description: Mother owl doesn't know whether she's coming or going when her three mischievous babies try to leave the nest.

title: Kangaroo Beach
description: Four junior lifeguards work under the guidance and encouragement of mature lifeguards to become heroes of Kangaroo Beach.

title: The Rhythm and Roots of Arthur
description: Arthur's family and Buster take a trip to the Read family farm where they learn about traditions and family.

title: Rosie's Rules
description: Rosie accidentally gives away her doll Lele on Donating Day; Rosie and Gatita volunteer for Seniors Day at the Nature Center.

title: High Hoops
description: It's school election week; can Aoife beat Clanger, so the Vipers don't lose the gym?

title: Wild Kratts
description: The Kratt Bros decide to split up to investigate the lives of being a predator and prey.

title: All-Round Champion
description: The athletes learn boarder cross with the help of Noah and two-time Olympic medalist Dominique Maltais; Paralympic snowboarding champion Alex Massie gives Rebecca a pep talk.

title: Old Enough!
description: 4-year-old Téo is wise beyond his years, but can he get a haircut all by himself? Then, 3-year-old Averie must brave the ultra-busy St. Jacobs market. Where does a kid buy an octopus?

title: Evolve
description: Patrick investigates whether nature's greatest survivors can inspire technologies that will help humanity avoid extinction.
